$comment: Listing metadata, applied by scripts/store-metadata.mjs in CI (manager/rules/SEO.md). actorId is added after the first deploy.
seoTitle: Deel Jobs Scraper - Every Deel ATS Career Page
seoDescription: Search every company on Deel ATS at once: job titles, pay, locations, remote work and posting dates. Newest first, read live, with no login or API key.

pricing.$comment: 2026-10-30. Rule: rules/SEO.md section 16. No actor is dedicated to Deel; anchors for one Deel job among multi-ATS actors: memo23/career-site-ats-jobs-api $0.004 plus $0.03 a run (85 u30, needs the companies named), fantastic-jobs/career-site-job-listing-api $0.012 plus $0.01 (1,668 u30, its own database), parseforge $0.004, hydrafetch $0.003, om_kh $0.0015 (1 u30). job-details is 12.5% under memo23 per row, with no start fee; start high while private: a cut is free, a raise costs a month. Gentle ladder per the owner's decision of 2026-10-29.

job.eventDescription: One saved job row: title, company, locations, work type, job type, department, team, pay, posting date, job link. Also one checked job link that is closed or not found.

job-details.eventDescription: One saved job row with full details on: everything in a Job row plus the description as text and HTML, pay as numbers with its currency, country and country code.

defaultRunOptions$comment: 1 GB: a pass over every page takes 4 s for $0.0011 of compute (2026-10-30, 100 newest jobs: 512 MB 7 s $0.0010, 1 GB 4 s $0.0011, 2 GB 3 s $0.0012), about 0.5% of the $0.20 such a run earns.
